They find out that even though the wood is no longer alive, dead wood is a home for animals, insects, birds and fungi, and learn that dead wood breaks down to give nutrients back to the soil. On the way, they have a game of tag by an upright dead tree called a snag!

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Canal Lock and GateMaddie is finding out about different gates that open and close. She visits a canal lock, to find out how canal boats travel up and down hill.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: S1 E18 — Amphibious MachinesMotorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that can go on land and water. Grace goes for a ride on a quad bike that turns into a jet ski, a vehicle that floats using its wheels and a pond weed cutter.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E11 — Autumn WalkIt's autumn time. Jud, Jessica and their class visit a local park to collect leaves for an art project. Back at school, they use the leaves to create a huge leaf print picture - and things end up getting messy. The school playground is covered in leaves and the school caretaker, Mr Clever, needs help clearing them up. Luckily, he has a team of super leaf sweepers, who come to the rescue.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S2 E14 — Swashbuckling SwordfishIn search of a mythical sword, Kwazii explores a pirate shipwreck that happens to be guarded by three swashbuckling swordfish.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: The Tale of the Journal's EndWhen Flopsy and Mopsy borrow Peter's journal, Peter has to save them from Old Brown, but will he lose his precious journal in the process?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E7 — The Pen Pal BadgeDuggee arranges for the Squirrels to write to some pen pals, helping them to learn all about life in far away places, earning their Pen Pal badges and making some new friends in the process.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E29 — The SlideNugget agrees to take on a scary new ice slide but loses her nerve, so Pancake comes up with a face-saving plan. But when disaster strikes, they decide to come clean.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S2 E10 — Toy Aisle TroubleEvil Pea takes all the toys in the supermarket for herself and the Cobs to play with. Supertato climbs a big wall of boxes to try and get the toys back.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E71 — Mission Rock BandThe girls want to put on a country music concert. Weasy comes along to help them, but he can't seem to play as part of a group and always ends up playing solo.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E45 — The Sticky Sauce SituationFabio's yummy new sauce is so sticky that he gets stuck to Mojo's bonnet. They have to do everything together until Bo figures out how to 'unsticky' that sauce!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E6 — Born YesterdayDad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E41 — OctopusWhen Chloe tries to teach her dad to improvise and play Bluey's game of Octopus at home, he finds it hard to understand, until they realise they can play it their own way.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard

programme.title: Blue Peter

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S3 E32 — Autumn: It's Time to Go StargazingJoJo loves her Captain Chloe dot-to-dot of the night sky and the treasure chest constellation that she's found. The constellation gives Gran Gran an idea. They can have a sleepover where they go stargazing in the garden.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S1 E30 — CameraInspired by a nature documentary, Sarah and Duck attempt to take photographs of birds.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Top FunPreston needs Mojo's racer top speed to get his new plane off the ground. But when his flight goes wrong, Mojo and Bo have to take to the air in Mojo's jet top to help him down!

programme.title: Chuggington
programme.desc: S6 E32 — Twin TroubleHoot and Toot have had enough. The twins' bickering has finally led them to separate and go different ways. But now they're lost without each other.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Treasure in the Plant AisleIn the perilous plant aisle, Supertato and Evil Pea team up to find treasure as they have half a map each, but she tricks him and steals the map to find the treasure for herself.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S1 E21 — BalloonBing and Sula find a helium balloon stuck in a tree in the park. They both want to play with it at the same time, so Flop makes two strings, and they invent a noisy balloon game called stuck duckies. When they run in opposite directions the balloon flies away, and Flop volunteers to be the stuck ducky, so the game doesn't have to end.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S2 E24 — FossilBing and Sula are building a stone tower in the Howly Woods when Sula finds an ammonite. Bing wants to find one too but is overwhelmed by the amount of stones, which makes it very difficult to find one. A frustrated Bing sits down, and Sula notices some ammonites in the rock behind him. Flop takes a picture of Bing and Sula with their ammonites.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E32 — The Voice BadgeBetty sounds like Roly, Norrie sounds like Tag, and Duggee sounds like Enid! The Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices. It is clear something has gone awry. Do not worry, Duggee has his voice badge, and he knows what to do.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E33 — The Island BadgeDuggee and the Squirrels are sailing. When Tag starts to feel seasick, Duggee suggests they stop at the island. However, someone steals their boat and all their food! Duggee has his island badge and knows what to do.

programme.title: Bluey Minisodes
programme.desc: S1 E4 — LetterNana reads an old story that Bandit wrote from when he was five. The kids find this hilarious as Nana is reading out the words exactly as they are spelt.

programme.title: Go Jetters

programme.title: Peter Rabbit

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S3 E15 — Red Rock CrabsWhen Shellington and the crew try to gather some skittish crabs who have drifted away from home, they get help from some old friends.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: S1 — Juno's Wiggly ToothWhen Juno the hippo has her first loose tooth, Vida helps her prepare for the tooth fairy.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E37 — The Swoppiton DuckMojo and Bo need Ted's help to pull a wobbly duck statue up Swoppiton Hill. But does Ted know the best way? And will there be anything left of the duck when they get there?

programme.title: Activate with Joe Wicks
programme.desc: S1 E19 — FootballJoin Joe on the pitch with Activators FC, ready to give a display of football excellence! This Football Challenge kicks off with toe taps, then knee smashers, followed by kickers. Have you got what it takes for the Activate? Get ready to move with Joe and the Activators.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S12 E19 — We're All Friends: Treasure HuntJustin and his friends go on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble has baked a cake for Aunt Polly's birthday, but the cake ends up having an adventure all of its own.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S1 E33 — Mums and DadsMae Indi a Rysti'n chwarae gêm o Mam a Dad, ond ma' nhw methu cytuno pwy ddylai fynd i'r gwaith. Indi and Rysti play Mums and Dads, but they can't agree on who should go to work.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E2 — BedroomBluey is excited to get her own room, but when bedtime comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S1 E46 — The Submarine BadgeIt's a day out for Duggee and the Squirrels as they go on an underwater adventure with Betty's dad in his submarine. They see all the wonders of the underwater world, including a giant sea stallion and some jazz fish. And to the Squirrels, all the coloured buttons that work the submarine are just as interesting as what's outside. Betty's dad has a tricky time amusing the Squirrels. Thank goodness for the school of fish!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S1 E47 — The Detective BadgeDuggee puts his delicious homemade apple pie on the windowsill to cool down, but the second his back is turned it's gone. Who took it? Can the Squirrels find out? Fortunately, Duggee has his detective badge - and there are some very small footprints to follow. The Squirrels go and find lots of clues to help Duggee solve the mystery. Being a detective is hard work!

Comedy, starring Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner and Jason Bateman.

With analysis by Roy Keane and Ian Wright, commentary from Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews by reporter Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: Saale Aashiq

programme.title: Tere Ishk Mein

programme.title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E10Experts look at three types of weapon employed to attack civilian populations, from the medieval trebuchet to modern bio-weapons and nuclear bombs.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Hawker Hurricane was the first RAF aircraft to fly over 300mph. Over half of every enemy aeroplane destroyed in the Battle of Britain was by a Hurricane, not a Spitfire.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II. Regarded as one of the most important aircraft of the Cold War. It was a major part of the United States Air Force, Navy and Marine Corps, and was also used by many other countries.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E1Historian Guy Walters begins his 4,000-kilometre European odyssey in Germany, tracing the first chapter of one of history’s most enduring legends. Alongside Justine, he leaves behind the archives to uncover the truth about hidden Nazi plunder.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E2Guy Walters and Justine pursue the Amber Room in Czechia. At Friedland Castle, rumours link the fortress to the missing treasure. At the notorious Prince’s Hole, Justine braves the cave while Guy waits outside, only to find nothing but spiders.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E2December 7th, 1942. Off the coast of France, ten British commandos board five canoes in the middle of the ocean. Their objective: to paddle to the Gironde estuary, then up the river to Bordeaux to sabotage German ships.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E1In the north of Crete, six commandos land in a cove. On this island that has been occupied for two years, they have been given a high-risk mission—to infiltrate the Heraklion airfield to destroy the Luftwaffe bombers and fighter planes.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Heinkel He 111 is one of the most recognised German aircraft of WW2. The broad winged design was a guinea pig for future bombers, with more variants than any other military aircraft of the time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6We trace the astonishing story of designers turning away from metal and back to wood to create a twin-engine bomber that could outrun almost any aircraft in the sky, yet deliver a bomb load greater than an Avro Lancaster.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E5Twenty-four-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop. He was captured, but became world famous after escaping.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E6The story of the trench warfare from the First World War is well known. What is less well known is that the efficiency of the railway networks of both sides helped cause that stalemate.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E4In the midst of the reconquest of Italy, the Allies came up against the Winter Line—an impregnable line of defence built on the crests of a mountain range. They decided to call in a very special commando unit, the First Special Service Force.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E3On September 15th, 1942, 12 commandos reached Northern Norway. Their mission: to sabotage a hydroelectric plant crucial to the German war industry. To avoid detection, they decided to cross a huge high-altitude glacier.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E1Adolf Hitler had a depraved sex life that he tried to keep hidden from the German public. He was said to be a chronic masturbator, a voyeur and that he engaged in sado-masochistic sex with women.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E2Hitler wanted the world to believe he possessed super-human qualities but in private he was a wreck. This episode reveals the archives that confirm Hitler’s genital deformity, the alarming truth about his heavy drug addiction and the Parkinson’s.

programme.title: Secret Sex Lives Of Tyrants
programme.desc: E5Uncover how Saddam Hussein ruled Iraq through fear and violence, leaving a brutal legacy carried on by his sons.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E4Destroyers and Cruisers showcases ships that with their speed and firepower became the backbones of 20th century navies. We tell the incredible story of USS Laffey, the WW2 destroyer that would come to be known as ‘the ship that would not die’.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E1Ranged weapons guarantee a warrior's best chance of survival. International experts survey history’s most important ranged weapons, from the Roman spear and the English longbow, right up to the futuristic railgun.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E2Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2Unusually, we look at the later, clipped wing version flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during WW2. We get close-up with a beautifully restored example, fly her and unearth long unseen test and operational footage.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E3At the Altaussee salt mine, Guy Walters and Justine discover replicas of looted masterpieces and reflect on miners’ efforts to save priceless works from Nazi destruction. At Hans’s mountain home, they study diagrams of vanished art.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E4Guy Walters and Justine follow one of the most famous legends of WWII: the Wałbrzych Gold Train. Their search through Poland blends tense encounters, eccentric characters, and moments of farce as they try to separate fact from fantasy.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5This episode tells stories about the secret world of naval deception and cloak and dagger missions. 1914, the yacht Asgard, manned by Erskine Childers, smuggled rifles into a fishing village to arm an Irish militia in their struggle for Home Rule.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6The 16th century witnessed a revolution in combat ship design and saw the birth of two legendary sea captains; Sir John Hawkins and Sir Francis Drake – both superb seamen and adventurers who would have a lasting impact on naval history.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E7Historian Neil Faulkner tells the story of Lawrence of Arabia and his pioneering guerilla warfare against the railways of the Ottoman Empire.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E8This episode features tales of the heroism of the railway staff during the Blitz, and how a small siding in a Hampshire railway station played its part in the preparations for D-Day.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7The Battle of Leyte Gulf tells the story of the largest sea conflict in history involving Pearl Harbor warships and the largest battleships in the world, and how the US Navy, despite kamikaze attacks and a Japanese decoy fleet, were victorious.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8In this episode we look at vessels built for amphibious combat. We begin by looking at the last reaming Landing Craft Tank (LCT) to serve on D-Day – LCT 7074. These huge landing craft were essential in delivering tanks, trucks, soldiers and supplies.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E31942. Nazi Germany's Blitzkrieg enters Egypt. Field Marshal Erwin Rommel, aka the Desert Fox, has his eyes set on Cairo, but first he must overcome General Bernard Montgomery, the British Eighth Army, and the area's punishing fighting conditions.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E4July 1943. For six months, the German advance has stalled, but Hitler is convinced that his new generation of Nazi tanks will help put the Reich back on the path to European domination. His target: the Soviet town of Kursk.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5This episode tells stories about the secret world of naval deception and cloak and dagger missions. 1914, the yacht Asgard, manned by Erskine Childers, smuggled rifles into a fishing village to arm an Irish militia in their struggle for Home Rule.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6The 16th century witnessed a revolution in combat ship design and saw the birth of two legendary sea captains; Sir John Hawkins and Sir Francis Drake – both superb seamen and adventurers who would have a lasting impact on naval history.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E1It took only six weeks for the Nazi Army to conquer France, with an onslaught of tanks, aircraft and German troops. Witness the extraordinary military success of the Blitzkrieg campaign, through rare footage and firsthand accounts.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E2On June 22, 1941, Germany launched Operation Barbarossa, a savage and merciless attack on the Soviet Union. Now, newly colorised film and amateur home movies provide an unprecedented inside look at this brutal conflict.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E6New weapons with devastating force shape the wars of the 20th century. International experts test the catastrophic effects of the three most destructive weapons of our time: the machine gun, hand grenade and tank.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E3Weapons experts test the physical and psychological impact of close combat weapons - the Roman short sword, the medieval war hammer and the bayonet.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E4From the crossbow to the Kalashnikov to 3D-printed firearms, weaponry designed for everyone can offer a decisive advantage in warfare.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The story of the prolonged development and the initially troubled operational history of the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. Forever known as the airframe that dropped the first atomic weapons on Japan, the B-29 lived on well beyond its war years.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E5Guy Walters and Justine across Italy in pursuit of Nazi gold. With historian Madeline, they uncover the story of Italy’s betrayal and looted treasure, before exploring the fortress of Fortezza and its underground caverns.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E6At the Fischerhütte restaurant, owner Albrecht Syen shares tales of past discoveries. On the lake itself, torrential rain and a comical attempt to use a GoPro as an underwater drone highlight the chaotic reality of treasure hunting.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E7A look at key maritime weapons such as the secret super-weapon that kept Constantinople safe for centuries, the thunderous force of a ship's cannon, and the deadly torpedo.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E8Examining how the techniques of ambush, along with weapons that remained undetected until the very moment they were used, would revolutionise warfare.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3Often called 'the forgotten bomber', the mighty North American twin delivered the first blow in the fight back against Japan, in one of the most daring and audacious raids of all time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4Cruelly called 'the packing case the B17 came in,' the Liberator more than proved its worth over Europe and the Pacific, patterning the B17 to deliver a blow to the axis powers in WWII however it wasn't simply a bomb delivery system.

programme.title: Combat Ships

programme.title: Combat Ships
